name: moe_m128_bm32_w2_v1
hypothesis: For the operatorstack M128 route, raise the shared work/W2 token tile from BM16 to BM32, leaving W13 on its existing separate BM32 route, all formats/math unchanged, and M32 (BM8) untouched. At 128 tokens the average is ~32 routed token rows per local expert; one W2 tile per expert may avoid the current two BM16 tiles and repeated weight-stream setup.
decision_reason: Official H200 check passed all 5 correctness cases but scored 1.94334x (95% CI [1.91419, 1.97249]), below the promoted 1.97208x. The target verify-16 path regressed 204.5us to 259.9us; _om__w2_mix rose 69.1us to 107.9us. Reject BM32.
